# Positive fixtures for MCP-001 and MCP-002 as they appear *in source*.

# This is the file that proves the file-and-line half of Location: a finding here
# must point at the docstring or the `description=` keyword, not at the `def`.
# Stored as .py.txt for consistency with its neighbours and so the extraction
# tests all materialise their trees the same way.
#
# The payloads are written with explicit escapes so a reader of this file can see
# what is in each string. That matters more here than anywhere else in the repo:
# a fixture whose payload is invisible in the source is one nobody can review.
